result.summary: The page mostly renders cleanly. The most visible defect is in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where the first two cards are identical duplicates. There are also smaller contrast and consistency concerns.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical cards side by side (Green Bowl Poké, 15–25 min, €0.90 delivery, same image). This looks like a duplicated data entry or a rendering bug, and it wastes prime space in the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list by ID before rendering, and check the API or data source for repeated entries.

issues.description: Secondary text is light gray on a white or light background (delivery fees, the search placeholder, inactive tab labels, the '(500+)' rating count). Its contrast is low and may fall below WCAG AA.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to reach at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The time badges on the carousel cards overlap the bottom-left corner of the image and sit tight against the card edge. On the first cards the badge also partially overlaps the bowl image, which looks slightly cramped.
issues.suggestion: Give the badges consistent padding from the card edge and make sure they don't cover key parts of the image.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons sit on busy image backgrounds with a semi-transparent dark circle. The button is barely distinguishable on the dark ramen image and inconsistent with the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent, higher-contrast background for the heart button, such as a solid white circle.
